nodes.rationale: Computed from weekly reports only, no LLM; every number carries its sample size and confidence. Triage levels are rule-based (insight_triage); AI only writes prose (PLAN.md P5), with unknown numbers replaced by [?].

nodes.label: project_insights_access.html (Insights permissions & mapping)
nodes.rationale: Who sees what is set only here, never automatically; wrong alias mapping would show a manager someone else's projects; suggestions are name-similarity only.

nodes.label: Blocker AI recommendations (POST /dashboard/projects/blockers/ai)
